title: Auto Farm I Kill Aura I Auto Second Sea I Auto Dungeons
features:
🗡️ Combat
- Mob Farm — multi-select mob list, auto island TP
- All Mob Farm — clusters of common mobs
- Kill Aura — radius slider + CD
- Multi Hit — up to 15 targets, range/CD sliders
- Auto Attack (M1)
- Auto Skill — Z/X/C/V/F, Smart/Instant modes, Boss-only + HP%
- Auto Combo — Normal/Fast modes, Boss-only option
- Auto Observation / Armament / Conqueror Haki

👹 Bosses
- Auto Farm Selected Bosses (multi-select)
- Auto Farm All Bosses (round-robin across islands)
- Summon Bosses — difficulty selector
- Pity Boss system — build pity 25 + use pity
- Boss Timer panel — live alive / spawn-in display

🎯 Quests
- Auto Ascend
- Auto Haki Quest
- Auto Demonite Quest
- Auto Sea 2 Map Quest

🏰 Dungeon / Events
- Auto Boss Rush — difficulty vote + auto-replay
- Auto Infinity Tower — auto-replay

⚙️ Farm Config
- Weapon Type select (Melee / Sword / Power)
- Movement — Teleport / Tween
- Farm Position — Behind / Above / Below

🛡️ Protection
- Anti AFK Kick
- Anti Knockback
- Auto Reconnect
- No Gameplay Paused

🎨 Visual
- Noclip
- FPS Boost

🌊 Teleport
- Island TP (whitelisted)
- All NPCs TP
- Sea Travel — First / Second Sea

📦 Misc
- Auto Open Chest (rarity filter)
- Auto Stats (multi-select)
- Redeem All Codes
- Webhook (data + rarity filter)
- Keybinds menu

📱 UI
- Mobile-friendly scroll
- 4×4 symmetrical Misc layout

And more :)
